rule_text.above_every_baseline_year: above every year in the 2003–2022 baseline (percentile ≥ 95)
rule_text.far_above_normal: far above normal: above the 90th percentile (P90) even at the low end of our uncertainty
rule_text.far_below_normal: far below normal: below the 10th percentile (P10) even at the high end of our uncertainty
rule_text.low_activity_guard: too little fire to judge (typical value under 5 and this value under 10) — no alarm
rule_text.live_spike: live spike: last-72 h detections at least 3× the expected count

backtest.method: Same percentile rules on raw (MODIS to 2011, unconverted VIIRS after) and harmonized monthly fire-days, each vs its own 2003–2022 same-month baseline; point percentile; low-activity guard on both.
